chunks: With this chain, from Al-Hasan, from 'Amir al-Khayyat, from Abu Hamzah, who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever recites Surah Al-Dukhan in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah will raise him on the Day of Judgment among those who are safe, shade him under His Throne, call him to account with a easy reckoning, and give him his book in his right hand.'

key_terms.الْآمِنِينَ: The safe/secure ones (those saved from fear)
key_terms.سُورَةَ الدُّخَانِ: Surah Al-Dukhan (The Smoke), the 44th chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards for reciting Surah Al-Dukhan in prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal* highlights the specific virtue of reciting Surah Al-Dukhan within the daily *Salah*, linking it to the intercession of the *Al-Aminun* (the Faithful). The promise of an 'easy reckoning' and receiving the scroll in the right hand underscores its role in securing divine favor and mitigating the severity of Judgment Day, a theme particularly resonant in Shia devotional practices.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  said,  “Whoever  recites Surah Dukhan in his obligatory and recommended prayers, Allah would raise him on the Day of Judgment among those who would be in safety and peace and under the Throne of Allah, his accounting would be easy and his scroll of deeds would be given in his right hand.”
